title: project.edit plan
description: The documents the edit covers and the digest that authorizes writing them. Two checks, not one: the plan digest asks whether this is the plan you reviewed, and the per-document digests ask whether the documents are still what the plan was built from. An edit made while a review was open fails the second even when the first passes.

rebases.description: What each rebase in the request resolved to. Reported because the operation derives it: a caller reviewing the plan needs to see which object the annotation is being pinned to and at what digest, and that is the whole content of a rebase.

documents.description: Every document the plan covers, in path order.

path.description: Path relative to the project root.

expected_sha256.description: The digest the plan expects to find there, re-checked at commit.

changed.description: Whether the rewrite would actually change anything. A plan may touch a document without changing it — a rename to the name it already has — and that is reported rather than counted as a change.

plan_sha256.description: Digest of the plan itself: the edits, the documents, and the digests they are expected to be at. What `commit_reviewed` authorizes against.

committed.description: True once the documents have been written. False for a prepared plan, which writes nothing.

written.description: Documents actually rewritten. Empty for a prepared plan.
